releaseNotes: v5.1.7 — Screenshot Reader destination picker redesigned: the three plain radio buttons are now three beautiful selectable cards (Save as trades / Fill an account / Both), each with its own icon, gold border + glow and an animated checkmark that pops in when selected, smooth 150–250 ms animations, all 12 themes. Same three choices and same behaviour — only the look changed. Same silent /S in-app update as v5.1.4 and same main-process OCR as v5.1.3.
